scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance for Research & Development Activities: Assistance to Industrial Association for Establishment of R&D Laboratories
other_conditions: Research and Development laboratories must be recognized by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) or the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
The laboratory must be set up by an Industrial Association that is registered under the applicable act.
Provisional approval of CSIR/DSIR must be obtained before project commencement.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to 60% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹5,00,00,000.
